title: The marketing mix
overview: A focused revision guide to the marketing mix.

sections.title: The marketing mix
content: The 4 Ps: Product (features, quality, branding), Price (penetration, skimming, competitive, cost-plus), Place (distribution channels), Promotion (advertising, sales promotion, PR).

examTips: For "recommend a pricing strategy", link back to the specific business's context in the case study — generic definitions alone won't reach top-band marks.
